newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline prompt bids $2 up, more backwardation.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline prompt bids $2 up, more backwardation.

text.p: NWE gasoline values were $1-$2 higher on Thursday on the very prompt physical market, although carge interest for August appeared lower and swap levels for the outer months displayed an increased tendency to backwardation.
One or two dealers claimed the lack of barge trades, coupled with indications of growing backwardation, suggested the market was now seen to be overdone and was heading for some downward correction.
Balance-of-July barge offers were nevertheless sustained at $199, $2 up, although bids were slower to appear and end-user interest in first half August barrels was seen limited.
Although August swaps were seen $2 higher at $195.50-$196, September backwardation widened to $6, with October another $4-$4.50 behind.
